Name: Marnie Narrative Overhaul
Author: haywrites
Description:
[color=#ff0000][color=#ffffff][color=#ff7700]Marnie[/color] the rancher! This mod takes her from barely a character to a fully fleshed out woman, who is taking care of Jas, her ranch, and a secret relationship with Lewis! As you get to know her, she'll reveal to you her struggles, her loves, and even some gossip.[/color][/color]

[size=4][b]This mod adds [/b][/size][size=5][b][size=4]in over [color=#ff7700]170+[/color] lines of unique dialogue! That's new lines for every weekday, of every season , and every heart level![/size][/b][/size]

I've applied my narrative design philosophy to make becoming friends with [color=#ff0000][color=#ff7700]Marnie[/color] [/color]a worthwhile experience. She is not romance-able, however!

[font=Verdana][size=4]1.3 And Beyond
With 1.3, the way .xnb files are found has been changed! In order to use my mods, you must
use the versatile and friendly Content Patcher.

How to install Content Patcher and the Mods:
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Download Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[*]Unzip the contents of Content Patcher into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Install any content packs (Narrative Overhauls) you want by unzipping them into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
A bit more complicated versus what it was before, but at least it will be possible!
For the Content Patcher version of this mod, download the 1.3 Multiplayer Patch Version of this mod!

(The latest versions of the mod files, uploaded 6/6/18, are the official versions, with the most up to date patches.)

PRE 1.3:
(THE BELOW WILL NOT WORK IF YOU HAVE THE MOST UP TO DATE VERSION OF STARDEW
VALLEY. See the "1.3 and Beyond" section above if you have the most
recent patch (1.3 Multiplayer)[/size][/font]

[u]How to install:[/u]
Incredibly simple:
1. Download and Unzip the XNB file.
2. Go to where you installed Stardew Valley.
3. Go to Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Dialogue
4. Move the XNB file over and overwrite the old one.
5. You're done!

This mod is [color=#00ff00]Rated E10+,[/color] and uses no Gender Pronouns for your player character.

[color=#fff2cc][size=5]Version 1.1.1 Available Now!
Patch Notes:
-Fixed a spelling error.[/size][/color]

[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Perfect 10 Edition Extra File:[/b][/size][/color][color=#ff0000]
❤For people who got Marnie's Heart Level to 10!❤[/color]
A best of mix of all the dialogue from this mod for every day of every season. This is for people who have had Marnie at heart level 10 for awhile, or got tired of what she says at level 10 with the N.O.

With this, you'll see dialogue you may have missed, and she'll have something different to say the whole year long!

The install instructions are the same as above, however, the perfect 10 edition overwrites the previous mod! Which is okay if he's at Heart Level 10.
